authorization.user_statement: Ok move forward chat, but please make sure you have taken your time developing this experiment. It sounds like we've made some progress, but I am still wanting us to push harder and get through this phase. I want it done correctly, under the same requirements we have already discussed, but we have used quite a bit a usage at this point, and I am wanting to see results and progress.

resources.memory_note: Rolling array inventory is not total process RAM; one 25-plane old NFHS mean bundle at a time.

focused_tests.correction: The synthetic reference manifest omitted game_id and approved_role required by the original score producer. Only test fixture metadata changed; the corrected failing test was rerun. Production code and the six passing checks were unchanged.

limits: All emitted record membership, evaluations, aggregates and decisions independently checked.
All gains/newly-nonempty-hidden claims reconstructed, plus every prior anchor and fixed first/middle/last frame of each window in each arm.
Ordinary negative cases outside that deterministic sample are not numerically reconstructed a second time.
SciPy components matched to emitted OpenCV indices by centroid, support and mass; no shared component-extraction function.
No models, checkpoint deserialization, images or video decoding. Old NFHS historical pixel provenance is not strengthened.
Candidate availability is an oracle upper bound, not selected prediction accuracy or quality acceptance.

usefulness_screen.meaning: Only justify considering one future label-blind selection experiment; no model, selector or phase promotion.
usefulness_screen.costs: Added hidden nonempty frames, off-reference candidates and ambiguity remain prominent regardless of screen.

decision.meaning: The frozen minimal usefulness screen passes. Additional recoverable centers exist in both development domains, beyond the prior anchors, with meaningful ambiguity costs. This supports one bounded fixed selector trial, not a quality pass.

next_step.work: One predeclared label-blind temporal selection and abstention comparison using the retained checkpoint and frozen candidate pool, with original selected outputs as the control.
requirements: Keep source timing, uncertainty, original evidence and protected holdouts intact.
Freeze one rule before execution; no threshold or hyperparameter sweep.
Require actual selected-output gains, no additional wrong selections or hidden alarms, and preserved easy controls under the existing comparison requirements.
Produce synchronized review output for any proposed changed trajectories; Ryan retains final visual acceptance.
Use the result to adopt the useful change or stop this route; no repeated aggregation diagnosis.
next_step.limitation: Even reference-informed selection restricted to this fixed pool cannot recover the 36 development frames with no accurate candidate. Those frames need separate detection or localization work; this result does not establish that new training or new images are necessary.

limits: Candidate availability uses labels diagnostically and is not usable prediction accuracy.
No checkpoint mixing, spatial merging, temporal selection, threshold tuning or blanket emission.
The original selected outcomes and failed continuation screen remain unchanged.
SAC describes training fit; DET/NFHS are development, not sealed tests.
Unknown geometry remains null. Existing holdouts and three pending motion reviews remain untouched.
Old NFHS caches retain original source/window/frame/model provenance, not invented captured PNG/PTS hashes. Their historical threshold0.5 metadata is separate from the fixed0.3 candidate extraction.
Candidate availability is a reference-informed ceiling, not deployed accuracy. Preserved mean availability follows from set inclusion.
Raw records and exactly equal coordinate groups are not counts of physical balls; nearby jittered candidates remain separate.
The old controls retain120available centers, but ambiguity rises7to20; future selection still needs explicit control checks.
All three retained-baseline NFHS gains are in P001 challenge; only frame217 is outside the previous37-frame context.

All emitted evaluations and summaries were independently checked, but only141frame-arms were numerically reconstructed independently; ordinary negative cases outside the fixed sample were not reconstructed twice.
Generated detailed candidate records and numerical outputs remain ignored; no new images/videos or human review claim.
